eligibility.base_definition: valid names, duration>0, finite raw features in[0,1], mode0/1, finite tempo>0, at least one mapped style; time_signature=3 correction only

numerics.boundary_exact_check: Fraction from original CSV decimal strings at score70/75/80 or core20 within1e-8; exact checks on all example selections
numerics.full_score_normalization: After recording boundary errors, exact Fraction component lookups normalize every score and confirm every threshold decision; float conversion occurs only after exact calculation to preserve mathematical ties in sorting
numerics.production_numeric_contract: not implemented; this reproducible analysis does not establish production arithmetic or publishing acceptance
